name: 2022-1c-recuperatorio-parcial1
title: CustomerImporter: Types, types, types
description: A CSV customer importer where a developer added, with nested ifs and isKindOf:, support for two identification types (DNI and CUIT) and two zip code formats (old 4-digit and new B1336BBE style), with their validations and type-testing protocol in Customer and Address. The student must remove the ifs and the repeated code with polymorphism while keeping the tests unchanged.

design.notes: The identification is stored as a type string plus a number string and the zip code as either an Integer or a String, so the model tests types with = 'D'/'C' and isKindOf:; the good design reifies DNI/CUIT and old/new zip code as objects that validate themselves on creation and answer the ifNone: protocol polymorphically, without touching the 30 tests.
